en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small mountain village nestled in a valley, with terraced fields and stone walls in the foreground. Several multi‑story houses line the hillside, and on the right stands a church with a tall clock tower and simple façade. Snow‑topped mountains rise in the background. At the top left in red lettering is the caption "Saluto da St. Orsola".
